About

Reading the signal inside the noise.

I'm an MBA Marketing Management candidate with a focused interest in business analytics — the discipline of turning raw operational data into decisions that move a business forward. My work sits at the intersection of market research, customer behaviour, CRM systems and reporting tools like Power BI and Excel.

Across internships and live projects, I've learned to ask the question every dashboard should answer: so what should we do next? That curiosity — paired with a growth mindset and a technology-first approach — is what I bring to every analysis.
